snippet.title: POCKET 37 - Trailer | 2026 Unity Game Jam
snippet.description:
The house always wins. Unless you cheat.

POCKET 37 is a short horror roulette game made in Unity for the Official 2026 Unity Game Jam. Sit at the table, place your bets, and try to rig the wheel without the dealer noticing. Get caught and you pay with a life and half your coins. Clear the tables and your prize is waiting at the exit.

Play free in your browser (or download for Windows):
whiterootstudio.itch.io/pocket-37

Made by WhiteRoot Studio
Made with Unity
Official 2026 Unity Game Jam entry
